description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade and image check functions for a variety of embedded device boards using OpenWRT. It defines functions to perform upgrades, check images, and copy configurations based on board types.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs a device-specific upgrade procedure based on board type and image type.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Validates the upgrade image for the specific device board.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration data to the device, specific to certain boards.
